better_than.task: Ethereum interaction in NEW TypeScript code
better_than.source: viem is TypeScript-first, smaller, fully typed, and pairs with wagmi; ethers stays fine for existing/mature code
@next-auth/prisma-adapter was renamed to @auth/prisma-adapter in NextAuth v5
Node 18+ ships a global fetch — node-fetch is no longer needed
jose is ESM, spec-complete, and runs at the edge; jsonwebtoken is CJS and Node-only
Travis CI has declined sharply; GitHub Actions is repo-native with a free tier
a managed email API (Resend) handles deliverability, DKIM/SPF, and React email vs hand-rolled SMTP

better_than.task: tabular prediction WITH nonlinear feature interactions
better_than.source: gradient boosting captures nonlinearity/interactions linear models miss — but linear is better for tiny data / interpretability

better_than.task: tabular classification with enough labeled data
better_than.source: gradient boosting beats naive bayes once you have data; naive bayes stays a fast strong baseline for text/small-data
